reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 111-120 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 10 candidates, 23 arms
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot (/tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip, SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a verified) was read after dropping every column containing 'cmax'. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex, fu, annotated form and application/population/funbound comments only. Original-source Cmax values were read only after the mapping was fixed by AUC0-inf/t1/2. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Open originals were read in full: PMDA IF PDF, PMC10013581 XML, the PMC1386360 scanned PDF (via headless browser because of the PMC proof-of-work gate), Scientia Ricerca HTML, the Wiley OA jcph.2206, the CT.gov API v2 results + protocol for NCT02891408, and the GSK CSR summary 117171. Closed originals were time-boxed to abstracts: Biomed Chromatogr 2015 dimemorfan, Eur J Clin Pharmacol 2017 dimemorfan, Eur J Clin Pharmacol 1984 xipamide, J Clin Pharmacol 1996 Y-27152. No account-requiring service was used and no one was messaged. IR is not inferred from route; conventional tablets/capsules not worded IR are verified_with_caveat, following the 81-90/101-110 convention. Transient browser files in the gitignored .playwright-mcp/ were deleted; no repository file was changed.
unresolved_issues: Haloxazolam (801): the manifest SMILES is flubromazepam (metabolite No.574); the PMDA IF states parent haloxazolam is undetectable in plasma. Ruled ineligible (metabolite analyte, n=1).

Y-26763 (45349): the source dosed the prodrug Y-27152, and Y-26763 is its active metabolite M1. All 5 arms are ineligible. Same prodrug/metabolite pattern as haloxazolam; the coordinator may want an FRDB-wide check of annotated_form != analyte.
Cefoselis sulfate (2198): the source is a 30-min IV infusion; the FRDB 'Oral' route is a coding error. Both arms are ineligible.

Firsocostat (59629): frdb_13189 and frdb_13191 share 6 matched normal-hepatic controls (CT.gov population note), so they are not independent arms. frdb_13193's 5 mg dosage form conflicts (results say capsule, protocol says film-coated tablet). All four are control arms of renal/hepatic impairment studies.
Solcitinib (8964): the FRDB comment says 'standard formulation', but the fasted arm is the NEW (poloxamer-free) formulation. The value is a geometric LSmean.
Phenoxybenzamine (1422): the dose is 10 mg phenoxybenzamine HYDROCHLORIDE (about 8.9 mg base) against a manifest 10 mg; the coordinator should confirm the salt-basis convention.

Dimemorfan (422): all 6 arms are unverified (both originals paywalled). frdb_941 has an abstract Cmax (6.19 +/- 7.61 ng/mL at 40 mg) fixed by AUC0-inf 117, but stage-1 fasting is not stated. Doses are phosphate-salt labelled.
Xipamide (492): the abstract gives a 40 mg single oral dose but FRDB records 20 mg (n=19). This dose conflict needs the full text (Springer, paywalled).

Paywalled originals needing library retrieval: Tan 2015 Biomed Chromatogr (10.1002/bmc.3325), Shen 2017 Eur J Clin Pharmacol (10.1007/s00228-017-2211-9), Knauf 1984 Eur J Clin Pharmacol (10.1007/BF00542150). The Y-27152 full text is not needed (ineligible from the abstract).

arms.reason: PMDA interview form for Somelin (haloxazolam) tablets, section VII.1(2)-(3), PDF page 22. After oral haloxazolam, the UNCHANGED PARENT WAS NOT DETECTED in plasma in any subject: 'いずれの例においても血漿中にはハロキサゾラムの未変化体は検出されず'. The only quantified analyte is active metabolite No.574 (7-bromo-1,3-dihydro-5-(2-fluorophenyl)-2H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one = flubromazepam), which is exactly the manifest SMILES (FRDB pk_analyte_pt FLUBROMAZEPAM). The reported peak is a metabolite concentration, and the arm is n=1. Ineligible: the analyte is a metabolite, not the dosed parent drug.

arms.reason: Ferry et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 1988;25:359-66 (PMID 3358898, PMC1386360; scanned PDF read). Group I is six normotensive healthy volunteers with normal renal function (3M/3F, aged 23-34). Subjects were overnight fasted and received a single oral 300 mg cicletanine at 08:00 with 100 mL water, with the first meal at 4 h. Total unchanged cicletanine was measured in plasma by HPLC. Table 1 Group I: Cmax 20 +/- 2 ug/mL (mean +/- s.e. mean). AUC(0-72 h) 115 and t1/2 7.4 h equal FRDB, which fixes the mapping. Caveats: the dosage form is not stated anywhere; the statistic is mean +/- SEM; the unit is OCR-rendered as 'p,g ml-' (ug/mL per the Methods and the text range 14.3-27.1 ug/mL); the second FRDB-cited source (Springer chapter) was not accessed.

arms.reason: Bapuji et al., Chronicles of Pharmaceutical Science 2018;2(2) (Scientia Ricerca, open-access HTML read in browser). A fasting 2x2 crossover bioequivalence study of phenoxybenzamine HCl 10 mg capsules in 12 healthy Mexican volunteers (7M/5F), with plasma phenoxybenzamine measured by LC-MS/MS. The FRDB arm is the REFERENCE Dibenzyline capsule: AUC0-inf 3746.5 pg.h/mL and t1/2 1.54 h equal the reference column, which fixes the mapping. The reference Cmax is 3332.3 (1898.02) pg/mL mean (SD). Caveats: the dose is 10 mg of the HYDROCHLORIDE salt (about 8.9 mg base), whereas the manifest gives 10 mg; the capsule is conventional (more than 85% dissolved in 15 min) but not worded IR; the fasting duration is not given beyond 'under fasting conditions'; the journal is low-profile.

arms.reason: Weber et al., J Clin Pharmacol 2023 (PMID 36700458), an open-access renal impairment study read in full (Wiley HTML). GSK Clinical Study Result Summary 117171 (GSK2586184 = solcitinib), Cohort B, a randomized 3-way crossover in healthy male volunteers. Page 3 table 'GSK2586184 (New formulation) under Fed vs. Fasted conditions': fasted Cmax 779.8 ng/mL, geometric LSmean, n=9. The fasted AUC(0-inf) of 4787.7 ug*h/L (n=5) and t1/2 9.7 h equal FRDB, which fixes the mapping. Caveats: the fasted arm used the NEW formulation (without poloxamer); FRDB's comment 'standard formulation' is a mislabel, because the standard poloxamer formulation was only given fed. The statistic is a model-based geometric LSmean, not an observed mean. The tablets are not worded IR, the fasting duration is not stated, and the study was terminated early for safety in another study.
